integrity: Exact formulas and the dimension-rigidity implication are derived analytically. The executable numerical checker independently corroborates them with finite randomized tests; finite simulations are not proofs. Related full papers were materially inspected and original source claims differentiated.
scientific_limitations: The orthogonal projected midpoint is uniform only for S^2 under the stated independent hemisphere surface sampling. The formulas do not address arbitrary caps, solid-ball sampling, perspective projections or intrinsic-constrained paths. Relevant older probability and integral-geometric literature may encode equivalent identities; absolute priority and independent verification are not established.
scope: Two independent normalized surface-area-uniform points on the round northern hemisphere; the midpoint of their shorter spherical geodesic and its orthogonal equatorial projection. Ambient dimensions two and higher are treated solely for the uniqueness comparison.
title: Uniform-disk law and Cauchy disintegration for hemispherical geodesic midpoints
